As a senior engineer at a FAANG company, I’ve collaborated with Sofia Hernandez on several high-stakes machine learning projects. Her role as Senior ML Engineering Lead at NexaCorp requires balancing technical rigor with strategic vision, and she excels in both.  

Sofia’s technical expertise lies in operationalizing machine learning systems at scale. She designed a production-grade MLOps framework that reduced model retraining latency by 40% for a global customer analytics platform. Her work with MLflow and Weights & Biases enabled teams to track experiments across 15+ active models, streamlining collaboration. She also pioneered a model deployment architecture that decoupled inference layers from training pipelines, allowing her team to scale deployments across three regions without service degradation.  

Beyond code, Sofia’s soft skills are equally compelling. She thrives in cross-functional environments, translating complex technical roadblocks into actionable insights for stakeholders. During a critical product launch, she mediated a conflict between data and engineering teams, aligning priorities through clear documentation and shared KPIs. Her mentorship has also shaped junior engineers—she regularly pairs with new hires, ensuring they grasp both the “why” and “how” of production systems.  

Sofia’s impact extends beyond her team. She spearheaded a company-wide initiative to standardize monitoring practices, reducing alert fatigue by 60% through contextual dashboards. Her ability to merge technical depth with pragmatic solutions makes her a rare asset. I wholeheartedly recommend her for any role requiring both innovation and operational excellence.
